protocol.design: rolling-origin walk-forward, disjoint test blocks, expanding training window
protocol.target: cpu_demand only (Azure has no measured memory column)
protocol.tuning: none - library defaults for every arm, so the comparison is like-for-like and not an artefact of unequal search budgets
protocol.test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on per-block paired differences
protocol.primary_measure: MAE ratio (model / persistence); <1 means the model wins
protocol.train_window_note: the expanding window is primary because it is what a deployed system does and because a short fixed window restricts only the learned arms - persistence needs no training. --sliding reproduces the fixed-window check.
